account:
Today has mostly looked like an ordinary working day. I made my morning market walk, saw the baker restock the bread stall at 10:50, and heard townsfolk report seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the inn and market. That fits supplying bread, though I did not personally see those deliveries. The neighbour says the baker is stocking fresh bread and the innkeeper is tending supplies. I reviewed the treasury during town accounts: it contained 128 emeralds, which I left untouched.

The only unusual news is the neighbour's report of rumours about a celebration or bridge changes. The neighbour has seen no evidence, and says the baker knew of no celebration. I have not seen any work or confirmed plans supporting either rumour, so I cannot say that anything is being organized or what it would be for. I also noticed a lantern appear in the town hall at (-58, -60, 31), but do not know who placed it or why. The builder is now walking nearby carrying a lantern; that alone does not connect the builder to the rumours.

There was some confusion over my tea address. The neighbour directly confirmed the dockside cottage at (16, -60, 105), where I have now attended tea. The secretary had checked cottages and asked warehouse workers without verifying it, then came here to confirm the address for the appointment book. The neighbour has now confirmed tea here at three each day and reports no local problems needing attention. The secretary says the appointment book is safely back in its chest and unchanged. It is now 16:02, and I need to return to the office for my 16:30 appointment. Tomorrow morning's scheduled business includes a grain inspection at the mill.
